$comment: Weights for the Combined Score. They are renormalized over the sources that were actually included in a given week, so a missing source never shrinks everyone's score.

rankCurve.$comment: Rank-only platforms get points = 100 * rank^(-k). With fitToReference, k is fitted each week to the real stream curve of the reference platform.

combinedStreams.$comment: When every included platform reports real stream counts (e.g. paid sources), the chart switches to true combined streams. YouTube views can be counted at a discount if you want.
